evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies outbound connection establishment in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.
rationale: Adds the `-outboundbind` configuration option allowing multi-homed node operators to specify source IP addresses for outgoing connections. Resolves long-standing feature request #6476 from 2015, providing clear utility for complex network setups while being safely deferrable as it does not impact core relay or attack resistance.
